subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar accept this lineage architecture now strictly as legacy-default shadow infrastructure, with production promotion deferred until stronger day-level parity and runtime evidence exists?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately reversible and well tested, but its residual daily errors and operational cost require repository-level judgment about the acceptable experimental boundary and future promotion contract.

options.title: Land shadow-only stack
options.body: Merge the prerequisites in order, keep legacy authoritative, and require a later maintainer-approved change with stronger day-level and runtime proof before production promotion.

options.title: Pause for stronger parity
options.body: Hold the stack until lineage replay demonstrates acceptable finalized-day accuracy and operational cost on additional affected real histories.

recommendation.title: Land shadow-only stack
recommendation.body: Merge the prerequisites in order, keep legacy authoritative, and require a later maintainer-approved change with stronger day-level and runtime proof before production promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the best available owner for accepting a large core-scanner architecture and defining its production-promotion boundary.
